introHtml:
Marketing directors and HR managers planning outdoor events or team-building activities need promotional products that hold up in real-world conditions. Whether you are outfitting a company picnic, a charity walk, or a trade show giveaway, the right outdoor gear makes your brand visible while providing genuine utility. From picnic blankets to fleece throws, these items travel easily and get used repeatedly, extending your brand exposure beyond a single event.

At Perfect Imprints, we stock a wide range of custom outdoor products designed for bulk ordering. Choose from water-resistant picnic blankets with carry handles, soft fleece blankets for cooler evenings, and sand-repellent options for beach events. All products can be decorated with your logo using screen printing, embroidery, or full-color heat transfer. Whether you need 50 units for a small team or 5,000 for a large festival, we have the inventory and decoration capabilities to deliver on time.
buyingGuideHtml:
When selecting custom outdoor products for your organization, focus on durability and material quality. Outdoor items face sun, moisture, and repeated folding or rolling. Look for blankets with reinforced edges, water-resistant backing, and machine-washable fabrics. Polyester fleece and nylon are common choices that balance weight with weather resistance. For beach or park use, sand-repellent fabrics are a smart upgrade that attendees will appreciate.

Common Use Cases

Promotional outdoor gear fits a range of scenarios. Corporate event planners order branded picnic blankets for summer company picnics or golf outings. HR directors use fleece blankets as employee appreciation gifts during the holiday season. Safety managers distribute custom outdoor blankets at safety fairs or outdoor training sessions. Business owners often choose roll-up blankets as customer gifts that stand out from typical logo pens and mugs.

Decoration Options

Your logo can be applied through several methods depending on the material and blanket style. Screen printing works well on smooth polyester surfaces and offers vibrant colors at a low per-unit cost for large runs. Embroidery adds a premium feel to fleece blankets and is ideal for smaller quantities. Full-color heat transfer allows photographic or complex logo designs on picnic blankets. For best results, request a sample before placing a full order to confirm color accuracy and placement.

Quantity and Pricing

Bulk custom outdoor orders typically start at 50 to 100 units for standard blankets. Minimum order quantities (MOQs) vary by decoration method: screen printing may require 100+ pieces, while embroidery can be done on as few as 24. Wholesale pricing drops significantly as quantities increase, so consider combining multiple events into one order to maximize value. For example, ordering 500 blankets for a year of trade shows and employee gifts often costs less per unit than two separate orders of 250.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

One frequent oversight is ignoring blanket size. A lap blanket works for indoor use but may be too small for a picnic. Check dimensions before ordering. Another pitfall is selecting a fabric that does not match the intended use — fleece is warm but not water-resistant, while nylon picnic blankets are waterproof but less cozy. Finally, confirm lead times: decorated blankets can take 10–15 business days, so plan ahead for event deadlines.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom outdoor blankets?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities vary by product and decoration method. Standard screen-printed blankets typically require 100 units, while embroidered blankets can be ordered in quantities as low as 24. Contact our team for specific MOQs on your chosen product.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer sample orders for most outdoor products. You can request a blank sample to evaluate material and size, or a decorated sample to review print quality. Sample turnaround is usually 3-5 business days.

faqs.q: What decoration methods work best for outdoor blankets?
faqs.a: Screen printing is cost-effective for large runs on smooth fabrics. Embroidery adds a premium look on fleece. Full-color heat transfer works well for detailed logos on picnic blankets. The best method depends on your blanket material and budget.

faqs.q: How long does production take for custom outdoor products?
faqs.a: Standard production time is 10-15 business days after artwork approval. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee. Shipping time depends on the carrier and destination.

faqs.q: Are custom outdoor blankets machine washable?
faqs.a: Most of our outdoor blankets are machine washable. Fleece blankets can be washed on gentle cycle and air dried. Picnic blankets with water-resistant backing should be spot cleaned or hand washed. Always check the care label for specific instructions.
